\begin{document}
\section{Positive times}
We first take $t>0$ and a damping $\eta>0$. The causal envelope is then
\begin{equation}
e^{-\eta|t|}\,e^{-i\epsilon t} = e^{-(\eta+i\epsilon)t} .
\label{eq:pos}
\end{equation}
\section{Negative times}
For negative times, $t<0$, the same envelope becomes
\begin{equation}
e^{-\eta|t|}\,e^{-i\epsilon t} = e^{-(\eta+i\epsilon)t} .
\label{eq:neg}
\end{equation}
